predecessors.name: Mayapan
predecessors.text: 'Can Pech was south of Ah Canul and north of Chakán Putum, on the coast of the Gulf of Mexico'; 'Most of Campeche's population lived near the coast'

successors.name: Spanish Empire
successors.text: 'Can Pech was south of Ah Canul and north of Chakán Putum, on the coast of the Gulf of Mexico'; 'Most of Campeche's population lived near the coast'

ledger.x: 1441: infobox 'Established: 1441'; 'In 1441, a civil war broke out between the Cocom and the Tutul-Xiu'; founder Ah k'iin Peech.

1531: 'In 1531, the Spaniards invaded again, directly into the city of Campeche'; the conquest page: 'In 1531 the Spanish moved their base of operations to Campeche, where they repulsed a significant Maya attack.'
End 1534 / early 1535: 'the Spanish retreated from Campeche to Veracruz'.
1540: 'In 1540, the third and finale invasion started in Chakan Putum'; infobox 'Disestablished: 1540'; the permanent Spanish council at Campeche is dated 1541-42 on the conquest page.
1540: infobox 'Disestablished: 1540'; by 1540 'only 5,985 people were left in the city, largely because of smallpox'.

wars.name: Spanish conquest of Yucatán (Campeche)
wars.outcome: 1531: the Spanish base at Campeche repulses a Maya attack; end 1534 / early 1535 the Spanish retreat to Veracruz; 1540: the third and final invasion; 1541-42: the first permanent town council at Campeche.
